screenshot_article.excerpt: When law enforcement opposes some pro-gun measure, the anti-gunners will run with that stuff like they're a combination of David Goggins and Usain Bolt: fast as hell and for days on end. But what happens when law enforcement groups don't support a measure?
screenshot_article.summary: Colorado sheriffs and the NRA defeated a state proposal requiring mandatory firearms training for concealed carry permits. The victory protects gun owners from additional costs and delays while maintaining efficient permit processing under existing law.
screenshot_article.title: Colorado Sheriffs Align with NRA Against Mandatory Training Rule
